set(GLM_IS_MASTER_PROJECT OFF)

set(GLM_BUILD_LIBRARY 	ON)
set(GLM_BUILD_TESTS 	OFF)
set(GLM_BUILD_INSTALL 	OFF)

set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_98 OFF)
set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_11 OFF)
set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_14 OFF)
set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_17 OFF)
set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_20 OFF)
set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_23 OFF)
if(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD EQUAL 98)
    set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_98 ON)
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD EQUAL 11)
    set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_11 ON)
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD EQUAL 14)
    set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_14 ON)
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD EQUAL 17)
    set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_17 ON)
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD EQUAL 20)
    set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_20 ON)
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD EQUAL 23)
    set(GLM_ENABLE_CXX_23 ON)
endif()

set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
	add_subdirectory(glm-1.0.3)
unset(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR MATCHES "Visual Studio")
	set_target_properties (glm PROPERTIES FOLDER "external")
endif()
